staging.staging_table_reason: SQL Server scopes temp tables to session; permanent staging tables ensure visibility across operations
staging.staging_file_source: S3 or MinIO object storage via loadFileDownloader

schema_management.table_creation: CREATE TABLE with Rudder-to-MSSQL type mapping
schema_management.column_addition: ALTER TABLE ADD with dedup guards

varchar_length.truncation: values exceeding configured length are truncated

bulk_copy.description: Rows are streamed via CopyIn API from decompressed gzipped CSV records into the staging table

encoding.diacritic_handling: strings containing diacritics are re-encoded to UCS-2 via str2ucs2 for SQL Server bulk load compatibility

bulk_copy.null_handling: empty strings are trimmed to nil
bulk_copy.type_coercion: ProcessColumnValue coerces int, float, bool, datetime values; strings are clamped to configured varchar length

deduplication.strategy: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY primary_key ORDER BY received_at DESC)
deduplication.description: Only the freshest row per primary key is inserted from the staging table into the final table
deduplication.primary_key_map: configurable per table (e.g., id for tracks, user_id for identifies)
deduplication.delete_method: transactional DELETE of overlapping rows via per-table primary keys

identity_merge.description: loadUserTables maintains union staging tables for identity streams, deduplicates existing rows, and refreshes identities atomically

field_mappings.loading_method: Bulk CopyIn via go-mssqldb driver; no Segment MSSQL destination exists for comparison
field_mappings.column_naming: RudderStack uses snake_case column names (e.g., context_library_name, original_timestamp, received_at)
field_mappings.type_system: Rudder types are mapped to MSSQL types: int→bigint, float→float, string→nvarchar, boolean→bit, datetime→datetimeoffset
field_mappings.staging_strategy: Permanent staging tables with gzipped CSV file download from object storage; deduplication via ROW_NUMBER windowing
field_mappings.tls_encryption: TLS support with configurable encrypt and trust_server_certificate options
field_mappings.encoding_notes: Diacritic characters are re-encoded to UCS-2 for SQL Server bulk load compatibility
field_mappings.varchar_handling: Default varchar length is 8000; MAX available for text/json columns; values exceeding limit are truncated

notes: MSSQL is RudderStack-unique warehouse destination. There is no Segment MSSQL destination, so payload parity comparison is not applicable. RudderStack loads data via Bulk CopyIn using the go-mssqldb driver with TLS support, permanent staging tables, gzipped CSV file download from object storage, deduplication via ROW_NUMBER() windowing, and UCS-2 encoding for diacritic characters. The warehouse integration is located at warehouse/integrations/mssql/. ClickHouse is the only other RudderStack-unique warehouse destination.
